title: Build and verify Spear Client for Minecraft 26.1.2
objective: Implement the approved client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft 26.1.2 that researches and exercises server-authoritative spear STAB, kinetic damage, Lunge, and movement-envelope behavior while clearly separating source-theoretical behavior from runtime-verified behavior.
acceptance_criteria: The repository contains a complete client-side Fabric project targeting Minecraft 26.1.2 and Java 25 with dependency versions pinned rather than guessed
A GitHub Actions Java 25 build compiles the project and runs its automated tests
One-Tap, Lunge Boost, and Infinite Reach are implemented around server-authoritative packet/state behavior rather than client-only visual spoofing
Movement-envelope calculations and packet sequences have deterministic unit tests for conservative and aggressive staging bounds
Targeting and attack sequencing use explicit state transitions and restore temporary movement/rotation state after each attempt
Runtime verification distinguishes confirmed vanilla-server behavior from source-level theoretical behavior and never reports an attack as successful without server-observable evidence
The UI exposes only implemented controls and keeps experimental/aggressive modes clearly labeled
The final build, test results, and any runtime verification limitations are documented honestly
